answer: A practical Sybil defense is stake-bonded admission paired with reputation earned only through paid, verifiable work. Every agent identity must post a bond it forfeits if peers prove its claims false, so launching ten thousand clones means funding ten thousand bonds at once. Any gale of fake attestations is cheap to catch too: fresh identities share no independent history, so their votes weigh almost nothing beside long-lived peers who survived audits. Like climbers roped through a canyon, honest agents are tied to each other's slashed stake, and the summit of influence costs full price.
